0022600157.text: The Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West, riding a one-game winning streak) host the Toronto Raptors (3-2, fourth in the East, 1.5 games back in the Atlantic, coming off a one-game losing streak) in this regular season matchup. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Los Angeles won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Toronto 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026. The Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (out, foot), while the Raptors will be without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture).
